title: Dragging to another technician shows the reassign message, same group none
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Location has several eligible technicians (Clockable, Active, role not Office / not Time Clock User, enrolled here) and seeded work orders spread across statuses (Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Review/Ready for Review, Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, Imported), including at least one with no lead technician.
custom_steps:
1. Drag a work order between technicians; confirm the Story 4 toast and header count updates.
  2. Drag a work order to a new position within one technician; confirm the position changes with no reassignment toast and no assignment change.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A successful between-technician move uses Story 4's toast and count updates.
  • Reordering a work order within one technician changes only its position, with no assignment change and no reassignment toast.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10052 — Story 9 Drag to reorder. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S9-R5, S9-R15 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R5: “Successful between-technician moves use Story 4’s feedback and count updates.”
  • S9-R15: “Reordering within one technician changes position without changing assignments or showing a reassignment toast.”
